beta_derivative_algebra: For fixed mu/delta, S=sum local log-ratios per support, L(beta)=logsumexp(logpi+beta*S), L'(1)=E_posterior[S], L''(1)=Var_posterior[S]. No beta other than1 is evaluated.

cases.intervention: Each context replaces only its observed descriptors by their within-study coordinate mean; original mu/delta/a and supports fixed. This retains case-level means and removes regional variation.

density_algebra: NLL=(-logp0-q*logBF)/(N_observed*64); lambda multiplies this training loss only. Inference uses a+logBF.
